accepted: For the eight named repeat-3/repeat-8 cells under the configured 100 us fixed latency + 25 us request overhead, 50 MiB/s, 4 KiB maximum-range simulator, both adjacent ABBA directions improve aggregate total p50/p95/p99/mean by approximately 56-64 percent.
Same-target repeat source work changes from control [L,R,0...] to candidate [L,L,...] while output hashes, source versions, typed refusal, and exact returned lengths remain stable.
tradeoffs: The candidate replaces later zero-source cache hits with target-sized direct reads. Per-invocation later-position simulator latency can regress by orders of magnitude even though aggregate totals improve because root materialization is avoided.
Local bulk and concurrent tail distributions contain greater-than-5-percent review triggers and material same-implementation drift; no local bulk or concurrent latency result is accepted.
withheld: No generic or local wall-clock, per-invocation, bulk, concurrent, allocation, RSS, peak-memory, physical-I/O, cold-cache, remote/network/device, decompression, native DOC/XLS/PPT, OOXML, ODF, RTF, or iWork performance claim.
